text: Chanting to David. O Jehovah, I called to thee; hasten to me; give ear to my voice in my calling to thee.
My prayer shall be prepared incense before thee; the lifting up my hands the gift of the evening.
Set, O Jehovah, a watch to my mouth; guard over the door of my lips.
Thou wilt not incline my heart to an evil word, to work works in injustice with men doing iniquity: and I will not eat upon their dainties.
The just one shall smite me; a mercy: and he shall admonish me, an oil of the head it shall not decorate my head: for yet my prayer in their evils.
Their judges were cast down against the hands of the rock, and they heard my words, for they were sweet.
As he cutting up and cleaving asunder in the earth, our bones were scattered at the mouth of hades.
For to thee, O Jehovah my Lord, are mine eyes: in thee I put my trust; thou wilt not make my soul naked.
Watch me from the hands of the snare they will lay for me, and the snares of those working iniquity.
The unjust shall fall into their nets together, till I shall pass by.
